records.reason: 庾道季 says "思理倫和吾愧康伯" — "in thought and principle, harmony and order, I am ashamed before 康伯." This is a comparative self-evaluation where 康伯 serves as the standard of comparison for 庾道季's own inadequacy. 康伯 is not an actor, patient, or participant in any narrated event; he is merely the person against whom the speaker measures himself. The occurrence is referential-only — it points to 康伯 as a comparison standard in an evaluative statement, not as a participant in a narrated event.

The text is 庾道季's self-evaluation: "吾愧康伯...吾愧文度" (I am ashamed before Kangbo... I am ashamed before Wéndù). The target occurrence 文度 (Wang Tanzhi) is the object of comparison/evaluation in Yu Daoji's self-assessment. Yu Daoji is comparing himself to Wang Tanzhi and expressing shame/inferiority relative to him. Wang Tanzhi is not participating in any narrated event here—he is merely the standard of comparison in an evaluative statement. The occurrence is referential-only, pointing to Wang Tanzhi as a comparison reference point rather than involving him in an event.
